title: Worldwide lead for an IBM product component, three years in
summary: I was promoted and named worldwide contact and lead for the Lotus Expeditor Webcontainer and portlet container.
what_would_have_happened: The component would have carried open severity 1 customer defects into its next releases.
the_call: Take end-to-end ownership: old versions, new requirements, customer problems and adoption by other products.
what_i_did: Led the component worldwide, solved two critical severity 1 customer defects, trained a backup and pushed adoption into other Lotus products.
what_changed: Brought open defects to virtually zero, with no severity 1 or 2 issues, ahead of the v6.2.2 and v6.2.3 releases.
